title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2025 of the European Union for the financial year 2025 - Adjustment in payment appropriations, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text: Takes note of the latest state of play regarding the Sustainable Fisheries Partnership Agreements (SFPAs) and welcomes the fact that, in line with the relevant provisions in the IIA, the budgetary authority has an active role in releasing the appropriations under reserve in function of the coming into force and application of the respective international implementing protocols;
